title: Mini Data Center Digital Twin
domain: AI Infrastructure and Digital Twin Operations
objective: Read tenant telemetry, diagnose simulated infrastructure events, use governed agent tools, and issue portable completion proof.

steps.title: Know the operating baseline
steps.prompt: Read IT load, PUE, thermal, network, availability, tenant, and source provenance.

steps.title: Do the incident simulations
steps.prompt: Compare normal operations with tenant burst, hot aisle, network loss, and UPS transfer states.

steps.title: Be a governed operator
steps.prompt: Use inspection, thermal mapping, and incident planning without claiming unverified physical action.

steps.title: Issue portable proof
steps.prompt: Review the completed tool traces and queue or synchronize the OPPRRC record.
